dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: As the General Mahamatra, I have to display the might of the Akademiya. Whatever enemy we face, I will give it my all.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: In battle, as with delivering judgment, the righteous must prevail. And so we must approach every battle with great caution.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I am armed with the determination to uphold the rules. There is no battle I cannot win.
